description: Redevelopment of the site, involving the demolition of all existing buildings, to provide three separate blocks ranging from 6 to 8 storeys comprising large-scale purpose-built shared living (co-living) accommodation and conventional C3 residential dwellings, community space, co-living amenity and support space, and education space; accessible car parking, cycle parking, access off Kennington Oval and Ashmole Street, associated amenity, play, public realm landscaping, servicing arrangements, and all associated works.
